scope: Source and genuinely completed/applied PNG settings. Native keys at seven widths (320 at568px height), exact raw draft/byte summary, measured text capacity, full active focus frame, complete invalid draft/error/ring/reopen recovery through native panel wheel when needed, same-active-control844x390 orientation, native backdrop wheel lock at a settled viewport and exact Escape/focus return. Across-responsive scrollY changes are recorded rather than asserted; native anchoring qualification remains separate. No physical/virtual keyboard certification.
